releaseNotes:
• Subtitles are remembered for each show, and come back on by themselves for the next episode.
• A Next episode button appears when the credits start.
• Skip intro, Skip recap and Next episode press themselves after 10 seconds (press BACK to cancel).
• Skip intro now works on many more shows, with timings checked to fit your copy of the episode.
• Online subtitles: better matches first, and adding them no longer pauses the video.
• Long descriptions and titles scroll so you can read all of them.
• TV guide: channels show by name only, and there's always something to highlight at the current time.
